queries: WITH rating_rentals AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS average_rentals FROM rating_rentals) SELECT AVG(rr.rental_count) AS average_rentals, AVG(rr.rental_count) - o.average_rentals AS average_above_overall FROM rating_rentals rr CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rr.rental_count > o.average_rentals

WITH rating_rentals AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS avg_rentals FROM rating_rentals) SELECT AVG(rr.rental_count) AS avg_rentals_above_average, AVG(rr.rental_count - oa.avg_rentals) AS avg_amount_above_average FROM rating_rentals AS rr CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE rr.rental_count > oa.avg_rentals

WITH rating_rentals AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS overall_avg FROM rating_rentals) SELECT AVG(rr.rental_count) AS avg_rentals_above_average, AVG(rr.rental_count - o.overall_avg) AS avg_amount_above_overall FROM rating_rentals AS rr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE rr.rental_count > o.overall_avg
